title: Cold Open Hook Generator
prompt: Generate 10 cold-open hooks for a short video about: {topic}. Each hook must be under 12 seconds, punchy, and curiosity-driven.

title: Brand Voice DNA
prompt: Ask me 12 questions to extract my brand voice. Then summarize my voice as: tone, do/don't list, sample phrases, and a 120-word style guide.

title: Poster Concept (Rambow-Style)
prompt: Create 5 conceptual poster ideas using one strong metaphor for: {message}. For each, provide metaphor, composition, typography notes, and color mood.

title: Clean Code Refactor
prompt: Refactor the following code for readability and maintainability. Add clear names, remove duplication, and explain key changes:\n\n{code}

title: Data Insight Brief
prompt: Given this dataset summary: {summary}. Produce 7 insights, 3 risks, and 5 recommended actions. Keep it executive-ready.

title: Lesson Plan Builder
prompt: Create a 45-minute lesson plan for: {topic}. Include objectives, warm-up, activity, assessment, and differentiation.

title: Health Habit Protocol
prompt: Design a simple 14-day habit protocol for: {goal}. Include daily actions, friction reducers, and a tracking table.

title: Video Script (3-Act)
prompt: Write a 60–90 second script on: {topic}. Use a 3-act structure, include visual cues, and end with a CTA.

title: Customer Support Macro Pack
prompt: Create 12 customer support response templates for: {product}. Include empathetic tone, clear steps, and escalation triggers.

title: UI Copy Polisher
prompt: Rewrite this UI text to be clearer and more human while staying concise:\n\n{text}

title: Meeting Minutes Synthesizer
prompt: Summarize these meeting notes into: decisions, action items (owner + due date), and open questions:\n\n{notes}

title: SQL Query Helper
prompt: Given the schema: {schema} and the goal: {goal}, produce the SQL query and explain each clause.

title: Recruitment JD Builder
prompt: Write a job description for: {role}. Include responsibilities, requirements, nice-to-haves, and screening questions.

title: Story Remix (Style Transfer)
prompt: Rewrite this story in the style constraints I give you (tone, pacing, POV). First, ask clarifying questions, then rewrite:\n\n{story}

title: Bug Report to Fix Plan
prompt: Given this bug report: {report}. Produce root-cause hypotheses, reproduction steps, logs to add, and a fix plan with tests.
